newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE OCT 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE OCT 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- French counter-intelligence services allegedly believe former defence minister Charles Hernu was paid as an agent of the Soviet Union and other east bloc countries in the 1950s and 1960s, L'Express magazine reports today. Hernu died in 1990.

-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe calls for a National Assembly debate over the planned sale of indebted, state-owned defence and consumer electronics group Thomson SA for one symbolic franc to Lagardere Groupe , after opposition socialist party called for parliamentary investigation on the planned sale.
-- LVMH to invest 12.6 billion francs to buy U.S. DFS (Duty-Free Stores).
-- Sema Group to buy France Telecom subsidiary Telis and France Telecom's 50 percent stake in Sema Group Telecom, for a total of 25 million francs.
